description: Your own trade, held against the desk's principles before it is placed: a named stop below the entry, the stop distance, the name's entry state, a report inside the hold and the market gate. Applies Coil's published principles to a long trade the caller proposes in a US stock or ETF, from three numbers: the symbol, the entry and the stop. Returns a verdict of consistent, wait or pass with every reason: the stop's distance as a percentage of the entry, whether the name's state makes the entry a chase, a report inside five trading days and the market gate for the name's book. Impersonal: it reads only the numbers given and never an account. dip: {ok, codes, setup}: present only for oversold-pullback candidates; a dip buy only on a completed hourly turn above the entry-quality and depth floors. Free: one name per call, states only and no scores, one market day delayed.

stop.description: The stop price: the level at which the trade is wrong, below the entry, e.g. 51.50
